title: 医学英语小样（④ 英语题目锻炼医学专业素养）
note: 20 道原创情境题，依据本科规划教材的相应章节命制，并用权威临床资料交叉核验；重点考查医学术语、病历安全、沟通、循证方法与临床推理，而不是孤立背单词。

questions.stem: A 68-year-old patient says, "I become short of breath when I lie flat and now sleep on three pillows." Which entry best documents this symptom?

options.B: Dysphagia aggravated by the supine position
options.C: Exertional angina relieved by three pillows

questions.score_rule: 完全匹配标准答案得 1 分，否则 0 分
questions.explanation: 选 A。Dyspnea 是呼吸困难；orthopnea 指平卧时呼吸困难加重、坐起或半卧可减轻，即端坐呼吸。题中需要垫三个枕头睡觉，因此 three-pillow orthopnea 能准确记录症状；dysphagia 是吞咽困难，syncope 是晕厥。
questions.source: 《诊断学》第9版·常见症状·呼吸困难
questions.source_note: 教材章节命题；K-EN-001 附 NCBI 临床资料交叉核验

questions.stem: A PRN analgesic order states only "morphine 2 mg IV PRN." What is the safest action before administration?

options.A: Give it whenever the patient asks
options.B: Clarify the indication and minimum dosing interval
options.C: Automatically administer it every four hours
options.D: Replace IV administration with oral administration

questions.score_rule: 完全匹配标准答案得 1 分，否则 0 分
questions.explanation: PRN 表示按需，但安全执行还需明确适应证、剂量、途径与最短间隔。信息不全时应先澄清，不能自行假设频次或改变途径。
questions.source: 《基础护理学》第7版·给药与医嘱执行
questions.source_note: 教材章节命题；K-EN-002 附 Joint Commission 官方资料交叉核验

questions.stem: Cardiac examination reveals a grade 3/6 systolic murmur without a palpable thrill. Which interpretation is most accurate?

options.A: The finding is internally inconsistent because every grade 3 murmur has a thrill
options.B: It is moderately loud and readily audible; absence of a thrill can be consistent
options.C: It is very loud and must be audible with the stethoscope off the chest
options.D: Its grade alone establishes the severity of the underlying valve lesion

questions.score_rule: 完全匹配标准答案得 1 分，否则 0 分
questions.explanation: 选 B。教材的 Levine 收缩期杂音分级中，3/6 为中度、明显可闻，通常无震颤；4/6 级才伴震颤，6/6 级听诊器稍离胸壁仍可听到。杂音响度本身不能单独确定瓣膜病变严重程度。
questions.source: 《诊断学》第9版·检体诊断·心脏检查
questions.source_note: 教材章节命题；K-EN-003 附 NCBI Clinical Methods 交叉核验

questions.stem: During handover, a colleague says only, "The patient developed SOB overnight." What is the safest way to enter this information in the medical record?

options.A: Copy "SOB" because all clinical abbreviations have one meaning
options.B: Document small bowel obstruction without further assessment
options.C: Clarify the intended meaning and write the full term with clinical context
options.D: Omit the symptom because abbreviations are never allowed

questions.score_rule: 完全匹配标准答案得 1 分，否则 0 分
questions.explanation: SOB 常指 shortness of breath，但缩写可能存在歧义。安全病历书写应先核实含义，再记录完整术语和具体临床语境。
questions.source_note: 教材章节命题；K-EN-004 附 Joint Commission 缩写安全规范交叉核验

questions.stem: A patient presents with BP 86/54 mmHg, HR 126/min, cool extremities and confusion. Which action should occur first while other team members obtain focused information?

options.B: Begin an ABCDE assessment and treat immediate life threats
options.C: Wait for all laboratory results before intervention
options.D: Provide a definitive diagnosis before reassessment

questions.score_rule: 完全匹配标准答案得 1 分，否则 0 分
questions.explanation: 低血压、心动过速、肢冷和意识改变提示循环灌注不足。应按 ABCDE 同步评估和处理生命威胁，而不是等完整检查后再干预。
questions.source: 《诊断学》第9版·一般检查与生命体征
questions.source_note: 教材情境命题；K-EN-007 附 Resuscitation Council UK ABCDE 官方资料交叉核验

questions.stem: Which handoff message best follows the SBAR structure for a deteriorating patient?

options.B: Situation, Background, Assessment, Recommendation or Request
options.D: Start with the complete lifetime history and omit a requested action

questions.score_rule: 完全匹配标准答案得 1 分，否则 0 分
questions.explanation: SBAR依次说明当前情况、相关背景、评估判断以及建议或请求。专业交接不仅汇报数据，还要明确担忧、需要什么以及多快需要响应。
questions.source: 《基础护理学》第7版·护理沟通与交接
questions.source_note: 教材章节命题；K-EN-014 附 AHRQ TeamSTEPPS SBAR 官方工具交叉核验

questions.stem: During skin assessment, the sacrum has intact skin with localized non-blanchable erythema. Which documentation is most accurate?

options.A: Stage 1 pressure injury; document location, appearance and preventive actions
options.B: Stage 2 pressure injury because all redness indicates partial-thickness skin loss
options.C: Unstageable pressure injury because the skin is intact
options.D: Normal finding that requires no reassessment

questions.score_rule: 完全匹配标准答案得 1 分，否则 0 分
questions.explanation: 完整皮肤上的局限性、不可压白红斑符合1期压力性损伤的核心描述。应记录部位、颜色、压白情况及预防措施，并持续评估；不能仅凭红斑判断为皮肤缺损。
questions.source: 《基础护理学》第7版·压力性损伤的预防与护理
questions.source_note: 教材章节命题；K-EN-016 附 CDC 收录的分期资料交叉核验

questions.stem: In a trial, an adverse outcome occurs in 20% of the control group and 10% of the treatment group. What are the absolute risk reduction and number needed to treat?
questions.score_rule: 完全匹配标准答案得 1 分，否则 0 分
questions.explanation: 选 B。对照组不良结局风险 20%，治疗组 10%，绝对风险降低（ARR）=20%−10%=10 个百分点=0.10，需治疗人数（NNT）=1/0.10=10。A 的 50% 是相对风险降低而非 ARR；C 的 NNT 算错；D 的 ARR 与 NNT 均不符合题设。以上数值适用于该试验观察期和人群。
questions.source: 《流行病学》·临床试验效应指标
questions.source_note: 教材章节命题；K-EN-020 附美国国家医学图书馆 MeSH 定义交叉核验
